en_how: Three.js builds the six parts of a cylindrical smart speaker in code (a lathed speaker cone, a circuit board with chips, a battery, an aluminium cap with a light ring), lights them with a studio environment map for the metal and catches only the shadow on a white floor; the layers spring apart vertically on staggered timings and later close back the same way, a 3D point on each layer's right edge is projected to the screen so Canvas can draw leader lines and material labels, and the camera keeps orbiting slowly.
